description: Every 30 minutes, checks Cliniko for newly-marked Did Not Arrive appointments across every configured practice, drafts a courteous follow-up with real open times and the practice's cancellation policy, and raises a WorkQ item with the No-show follow-up approval form attached. Nothing is sent until that item is approved.
